paper_title: Knowing You Don't Know Learning When to Continue Search in Multi-round   RAG through Self-Practicing
caption: Ablation study on different Critic model choices. Both follow the SIM-RAG setting with GPT-4 as the Reasoner, but the blue bar uses learned Flan-T5-783M as a Critic, while the red bar uses GPT-4 as the Critic (a.k.a., self-critique).
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates a comparison of performance metrics between two models, Flan-T5-783M and GPT-4, across six different datasets. The horizontal axis displays the dataset names: TriviaQA (EM), HotPotQA (EM), 2Wiki (EM), TriviaQA (F1), HotPotQA (F1), and 2Wiki (F1), arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis represents a numerical scale ranging from 25 to 85, labeled without units, with tick marks placed at intervals of 10. For each dataset, there are two adjacent bars: a blue bar representing Flan-T5-783M and a red bar representing GPT-4. The blue bars show values of 77.3, 44.5, 82.8, 49.7, and 53.3, while the corresponding red bars display values of 77.1, 37.0, 83.8, 43.3, and 38.1. The bars are not visually emphasized with any shading, bolding, outlines, or annotations.
